svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Blank 100 x 450 mm, 3 mm aluminium. Front view is the face toward the road.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights up from the bottom edge; sideways from the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band slots 3 x 15 mm at 40 mm each side, centred 25 and 425 mm up:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain drill 3 mm and file square. The band clamps pass through these.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: V-block screws 4.5 mm at 18 mm each side, 25 and 425 mm up; countersink

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the front so the M4 heads sit flush under the band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brace clip bolts 6.6 mm on the centre line, 60 and 94 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Through-bolt hole 8.5 mm on the centre line, 225 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Arm cleat bolts 6.6 mm at 38 mm each side, 357 and 393 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two windows 60 x 90 mm, centred 164 and 285 mm up (saves weight):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 10 mm in the corners, cut between with a jigsaw, file straight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr every hole and edge; round the corners to about 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lay the V-blocks, cleats and clip on it; every hole lines up.
